name: 3D Animation
traits: modelled, rounded forms with appealing stylised proportions
smooth surfaces with soft subsurface skin and clean materials
dimensional depth with soft depth of field
volumetric light, warm bounce and clear rim light
bestFor: products shown in true shape and material
suits: almost any physical product, especially bottles, packaging, toys, devices and food; warm, family-friendly, optimistic brands
stylePara: Stylised 3D animated feature look: characters are modelled with rounded, appealing proportions, slightly large heads and eyes, simplified hands and soft sculpted hair masses; skin has soft subsurface scattering, fabrics show gentle fibre texture, glass and plastic read as clean physical materials; dimensional depth with a soft depth of field; warm key light, cool fill, a clear rim light separating each figure, warm bounce light from surfaces and visible volumetric light shafts through windows; rich but controlled colour; global illumination and soft contact shadows ground everything.

rendering.line: no outlines: forms read by modelling, rim light and shadow
rendering.shading: physically based shading with subsurface skin, soft ambient occlusion and contact shadows
rendering.colour: rich, warm, harmonious colour script per scene; saturated accents on characters; product colours and materials exact
rendering.texture: subtle surface detail: fabric weave, wood grain, slight skin pores smoothed away; clean, never gritty
rendering.lighting: warm key, cool fill, rim light, bounce light and volumetric shafts; soft depth of field

motion: Full character animation at 24 fps on ones: clear anticipation, follow-through and overlapping action in hair and clothes, gentle squash and stretch on faces, appealing arcs; weight and timing exaggerated a little past real life; eyes and brows carry the acting.
camera: Virtual-camera grammar used with restraint: a slow dolly or crane, a gentle push-in on emotion, rack focus between product and face, a low-angle wide for scale; physically plausible moves, no impossible spins.
avoid: photoreal humans with real skin pores
uncanny realistic eyes on stylised faces
printed fake text on packaging and signs
sheets: Each character sheet is a 3D turnaround render (front, three-quarter, side, back) in neutral grey studio light, plus two expressions; places get a wide and a reverse render in the scene's lighting; the product is a clean 3D render with exact shape, materials and label colours, ideally from our own Blender model.
risk: Seedance holds this style well, but faces drift between shots (eye spacing, nose shape, hair volume); send the turnaround in every shot. It can push toward photorealism in close-ups; repeat 'stylised 3D animated, rounded proportions'. Labels warp on rotating products; keep the label toward the lens and cut in the real packshot if needed.

example.prompt: Stylised 3D animated still: a woman in her thirties with a dark sculpted bun and an orange knit top, rounded appealing proportions and expressive eyes, holds a small green glass bottle with a yellow cap whose glass catches warm light; a sunny modelled kitchen with soft depth of field and volumetric light shafts through the window, a droopy fern on the windowsill, warm key, cool fill, a clear rim light, soft contact shadows on the counter. Vertical 9:16. No text.
